runtime.cpp
start_task(...)
create PimJob:
job.command_stream =
std::make_shared(
&artifacts.commands,

req.request_id)

LogicalTemplateCommandStream::next()
1. read LogicalCommand
2. encoder->encode(cmd, request_id)
3. fill GeneratedCommand
4. set expects_callback
